scenes.text: Hey M D C, I'm Finn. This is the Civic Action Scorecard Planner. Free, fast, and it does the math for you. Here's the tour.
scenes.caption: Hey MDC, I'm Finn. This is the Civic Action Scorecard Planner. Free, fast, and it does the math for you. Here's the tour.

scenes.text: All one hundred and twenty four actions. Five categories. Four phases that pace your whole year.
scenes.caption: All 124 actions. Five categories. Four phases that pace your whole year.

scenes.text: Finish something? Check it off. The points land instantly.
Set a goal. Say, Silver by finals week. The planner tells you the weekly pace, and whether you're on track.
Want to map it out? Hit Plan. Light blue shows where your plan takes you.
Open any action. What to submit, plus the three reflection questions. Draft right here. Green means you've written enough.
Ready to submit? Press Open Engage M D C. It lands on that exact action. Copy each answer. Your words, straight into the form.
scenes.caption: Ready to submit? Press Open EngageMDC. It lands on that exact action. Copy each answer. Your words, straight into the form.

scenes.text: Put it on your phone. It works like an app, even offline. Sign in, and your progress follows you.
Plan it here. Do it out there. Prove it in Engage M D C. Find it at civic action planner dot github dot I O. See you out there, Sharks.
